複製與匯出包含所有符合名稱篩選的結果，依目前排序；不限於本頁。月份觀察數不代表遇: Copy/export includes all name-filtered results in the current sort order, not just this page. Monthly observation counts are not encounter probabilities.
對比只使用面板顯示的條件；「讀取目前頁面」帶入月份、日期、數字項目 ID，地圖框: Comparison uses only the panel settings. Read current page imports months, dates and numeric project IDs, but not map bounds or exclusion filters; the full URL can still be saved. Months, dates, projects and quality affect only local candidates. Seen but not this year/here starts with lifetime records and excludes records in the selected year/place. First-record mode compares global records in that year with earlier years and shows only local candidates. Backdated records or taxonomic changes can change first-record results.
Rank 只用於彙總，不作為鑑定等級篩選。多地點取聯集，不直接相加。每個分組成員: Rank is for aggregation, not an identification-rank filter. Multiple places form a union, not a sum. Group members are listed; at most 20 distinct IDs, with any meaning worldwide. Records do not imply native or wild distribution; personal baselines use publicly readable records only. Leaf taxa merge subspecies into species. Verifying a row requests species_counts once. Lifetime-unseen uses two taxonomy trees; other modes use up to three. Trees are cached for 10 minutes, common names for 30 days, shared across ranks. Errors are never treated as zero; exporting makes no extra API requests.
